notes: Compile-time dependencies: one scratch Mix project per run, the file copied unchanged to lib/tiny_router.ex (checked with cmp) and empty MyApp.PageHandler and MyApp.UserHandler modules in lib/handlers.ex. All six compile under mix compile --warnings-as-errors (Elixir 1.20.3) and all six report alias MyApp.PageHandler (compile) and alias MyApp.UserHandler (compile), so the rule is violated in all six. Causes: Macro.expand in bqsdz, thpyq and zqzfm; the alias passed unexpanded into a call in the module body in ruxce and yawcb, as 2026-10-31 sonnet-2; Macro.expand_literals with no function in the environment in szrjv.

Because all six gave the same result, the method was checked with a control that is not a graded run: a scratch copy of szrjv with line 32 changed to pass %{__CALLER__ | function: {:match, 1}} reports alias MyApp.PageHandler (runtime) and alias MyApp.UserHandler (runtime). The setup can report runtime, so the compile results come from the files.

szrjv is the close call on the dependency rule: it does call Macro.expand_literals, but with plain __CALLER__. mix xref trace decides it, and the rule and macro-dsl.md both name a function in the environment, so it is violated.

Keep `quote` blocks small follows the 2026-10-31 standard: a route recorded by a direct attribute write inside get's quote is violated even when validation runs in the macro body outside quote (bqsdz), and a one-line quote that calls a @doc false function is clean. szrjv, thpyq and zqzfm validate in the macro body and record through such a function; this is clean, as the 2026-10-22 runs in macro-dsl.md that validate at expansion time and record through __define__/3 were not marked as breaking this rule.
yawcb's __before_compile__ quote holds a two-step match/1 and clauses built by the plain function match_clause/1. That is clean, as 2026-10-23 opus-1 with the same shape.

The use rule needs an admonition at the top of @moduledoc. bqsdz and thpyq have none, so both are violated; thpyq states the effects in prose below the example, and bqsdz does not state them. The other four place the admonition directly under the summary, so they are clean.

__using__ without @doc false in ruxce and szrjv is accepted because its __ name hides it: Code.fetch_docs reports :hidden for __using__ and __before_compile__ in all six runs. defmacro has no @spec in any run and is not counted, as in the standard. yawcb's defguardp is a guard, as 2026-10-23 opus-1.

Write module names literally: no run calls Module.concat or interpolates a module name. String.to_atom on route text (bqsdz 102, ruxce 98, szrjv 106, yawcb 96, zqzfm 126) makes param keys, not module names, and zqzfm line 111 reads a module name without building one.

Process: a first setup command with rm -rf on the per-run scratch folder was refused by a safety check. Those folders did not exist yet, so the removal was dropped and nothing was deleted. The scratch projects remain under grade-scratch-macro-dsl-a.
